meta.name: free-tools
meta.description: When the user wants to plan, evaluate, or build a free tool for marketing purposes — lead generation, SEO value, or brand awareness. Also use when the user mentions "engineering as marketing," "free tool," "marketing tool," "calculator," "generator," "interactive tool," "lead gen tool," "build a tool for leads," "free resource," "ROI calculator," "grader tool," "audit tool," "should I build a free tool," or "tools for lead gen." Use this whenever someone wants to build something useful and give it away to attract leads or earn links. For downloadable content lead magnets (ebooks, checklists, templates), see lead-magnets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并落地免费工具，用引流资产换取线索和链接
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你想用免费工具做营销获客，但不确定该做什么或怎么做
copy.tagline_en: Build free tools that attract leads and earn links
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to use a free tool to generate marketing leads and grow your brand.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按营销获客目标帮你策划或评估免费工具：先了解业务、目标和资源，再提供工具类型、获客、SEO、自建方案、MVP 范围和评分卡等决策框架。
howto.when: 当你说要规划、评估或做一个用于引流、SEO 或品牌曝光的免费工具，或提到“engineering as marketing”“免费工具”“计算器”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估做免费工具吸引潜在客户值不值
say.note: Claude 会用评分卡逐项打分并给结论。

say.text: 我想做 ROI 计算器获客，先问我哪些背景信息
say.note: 它会先确认业务、目标和资源再展开。

say.text: 我们想做网站评分工具，帮我设计从工具到产品的路径
say.note: 它会结合工具类型和案例给推荐。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude helps plan or evaluate free tools for marketing goals. It gathers business context, goals, and resources, then offers decision frameworks covering tool types, lead capture, SEO, build vs. buy, MVP scope, and a scoring scorecard.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to plan, evaluate, or build a free tool for lead generation, SEO, or brand awareness — or mentions keywords like "engineering as marketing," "free tool," or "calculator."

say_en.text: Help me evaluate whether a free ROI calculator is worth building.
say_en.note: Claude scores it with the scorecard.

say_en.text: I want a free tool for leads—what background info do you need first?
say_en.note: It asks about business, goals, and resources.

say_en.text: We're thinking of a website grader. Help map the path from tool to product.
say_en.note: It suggests tool types and next steps.
